text: Illustrate the story here: Lily's Puppy Lily had been wishing for a puppy for a long time. She wanted a silly puppy to run and jump with. But her mommy said Lily could not have one because she was only seven. Lily begged her mommy and daddy. She said, "I am not a baby. It would make me so happy to have a puppy." Lily's mommy and daddy talked for a long time. They said, "We do think you will try your best. We will let you have a puppy." Lily was so happy. She went to the pet shop and picked a tiny puppy. She named him Cody. Cody is the best puppy for this family.
